title: Leaders
subtitle: Each location has 1 leader, who is the person that signs in for it. The leader requests access by signing in with Google (requests show up here at the top) or you register them manually with e-mail and password.
search: Search location, leader, e-mail or phone...
howTo: Replacing or removing a leader revokes their access immediately. Units with a "legacy login" still sign in with the unit e-mail: on the next sign-in the system requires the person to update their profile and connect their Google account, and they show up here as a leader "to review".
replaceConfirm:
The location {{unit}} already has the leader {{current}}.

Replace with {{name}}? The current leader loses access.
replacedReason: Replaced by {{name}} as the location leader.
removeConfirm:
Remove {{name}} as leader of {{unit}}?

This person loses access to the system immediately.
createdManual:
Leader {{name}} registered!

Tell them to sign in with the e-mail {{email}} and the password you set.

modal.replaceWarning: This location already has the leader {{name}}. When you save, they lose access and the new leader takes over.
modal.name: Full name
modal.emailLocked: The sign-in e-mail can't be changed here. To change it, register the leader again.
modal.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Share the password with the leader.

errors.name: Enter the full name (at least 3 letters).

errors.emailInUse: This e-mail already has a login. Use another e-mail, or ask the person to sign in with Google and approve the request.
errors.assume: Could not set you as leader.

promote.title: Make an existing user leader
promote.help: For the group class teacher who will lead the location. They remain a teacher: they still see their classes and payments. If they stop being the leader, they go back to being only a teacher.
promote.search: Search teacher by name or e-mail...
promote.noTeachers: No teacher with a login found.

now.leaderNoUnit: is currently a leader WITHOUT a location (cannot validate). Saving here fixes it.
now.sameUnit: is already the leader of this location (saving only checks the data).

promote.confirm: Make {{name}} the leader of {{unit}}? They remain a teacher.
promote.confirmLeaves: They stop being the leader of {{unit}}.
promote.confirmReplaces: The current leader, {{current}}, leaves the location (if also a teacher, they go back to being only a teacher).

errors.read: Could not check this person's access.
errors.noLogin: this teacher has no login. Create the login in the Teachers tab first.
errors.isManager: is an admin or mentor. To be the leader, they use the "I am the leader" button themselves.
errors.blocked: has blocked access. Unblock it in Access Control first.
errors.otherRole: has a different access level ({{role}}). Adjust it in Access Control first.
